description.value: Grand Honour is a Chinese restaurant located on Granville Street in South Vancouver, offering both lunch and dinner service. It operates out of a ground-floor unit in a mixed-use building and seats guests indoors. Cyclists riding the Granville corridor would find it a convenient stop for a sit-down Chinese meal.

address.value: B1-5701 Granville Street, Vancouver, British Columbia, V6M 4J7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and provides authoritative contact details (address, phone, email) not present in OSM. OSM confirms it is a Chinese restaurant with indoor seating and no outdoor seating. The website content is minimal (built on Google Sites) and contains no cycling-relevant information — bike parking, water refill, and washroom details are all absent, leaving all three required WWC criteria unconfirmed.
concerns: OSM name is 'Grand Honour' but the website consistently uses 'Grand Honour Restaurant' — OSM record may need a name update.

On-the-ground verification is needed before a listing can be justified.
